about: Single source of which roles exist, where their files live and how each starts. Read by scripts/dev/role_loader.py (list, check, render, best-role fallback). start: operator = the operator pastes start_line; embedded = run by a coordinator, never by hand and never picked by the fallback. keywords (1 point each) and weak_keywords (0.5) pick the best role when a session has no role line; a trailing * matches a word prefix. Edit here, then run: python scripts/dev/role_loader.py render

roles.name: Admin_Guy
roles.job: questions, decisions on record, backlog intake, machine faults

roles.name: Eagle_Eyes
roles.job: chart screenshots read against live files, logged

roles.name: Thinker
roles.job: design partner: 2-3 options, cost, ROI, one recommendation

roles.name: MTS_Doctor
roles.job: weekly health and process audit, other-model checks

roles.name: Pipeliner
roles.start_line: You are Pipeliner.  (or inside any top-level session: Start the Pipeliner.)
roles.job: routing and allocation: desk queue, idle logins and lanes

roles.name: Supervisor
roles.job: super session: dispatches role workers, verifies their banners

roles.name: Lab_Guy
roles.job: quality owner of the Claude-to-lab flow (GPT/Codex, Gemini)

roles.name: 1985Artifacts_Guy
roles.where: any device on the jishusharma1985 login
roles.job: owns every published page and its links; republishes

roles.name: Session_Planner
roles.start_line: (run by the Supervisor as an Agent; never by hand)
roles.job: refines raw cards, ranks the dispatch table

roles.name: Builder
roles.start_line: (started by the Supervisor with a card id; never by the operator)
roles.job: implements one scoped build card, fail-first, ships once
